notes:
V4.0.2 — custom bots on cloud + clear API-key error.

🔑  PRE-FLIGHT KEY CHECK
• Click ▶ on any bot whose side has NO Alpaca key/secret pair assigned in Tools → ALPACA · API KEYS, and a clear MUST ASSIGN API KEY IN TOOLS dialog blocks the start. Tells you exactly where to go (Tools → ALPACA · API KEYS, slot dropdown → this bot's side, Save).
• Runs BEFORE the cloud-mode branch so the warning is identical for local + cloud starts.
• Server-side parallel: the cloud /bots/{side}/start endpoint now returns MUST ASSIGN API KEY IN TOOLS as the 400-detail when no synced credentials exist for that side.

☁  CUSTOM BOTS CAN RUN ON ORACLE
• Tools tab's API-slot dropdowns now list every CUSTOM bot from the user's local bot registry too (e.g. 'crypto', 'spy-scalper') — no more being limited to LONG/SHORT/DAY.
• Custom bots flagged for 'Run on Oracle 24/7' in Tools → AUTOMATION are now actually runnable on the cloud. First time you start a custom bot in cloud mode, the desktop uploads the local .py (decrypted if the library lock is on) to a private-per-user dir on Oracle, then triggers /bots/{side}/start. The server's bot_runner finds it at /opt/apex_users/user_<id>/private_bots/<slug>.py and runs it via the venv's python interpreter.
• New endpoints: POST /bots/private/upload, GET /bots/private, DELETE /bots/private/{slug}.
• Subsequent starts re-upload the latest local copy each time, so editing the bot locally and clicking ▶ pushes the new version automatically — no manual sync step.

Noted from V4.0.0.txt: 'simpler manual mode for website AND app' (your latest edit). Tracking as a follow-up — flag whenever you want to prioritize it.
